name: Anka Weiss
bio: Calm under fire. Commands the school's medium tank like she was born in it.

name: Mina Falkenrath
bio: Gunnery prodigy with a grudge against paper targets.

name: Juno Akiyama
bio: Drives like the brakes are a suggestion.

name: Elsa Brandt
bio: Sees everything, says little. The recon section is hers.

name: Petra Voss
bio: Firing solutions by intuition, confirmed by mathematics.

name: Irma Krieger
bio: Captain of the Iron Valkyries. Textbook doctrine, ruthlessly applied.

name: Sofia Ravenna
bio: Valkyrie flanker. Fights on instinct and espresso.

name: Nadja Orlov
bio: Tank destroyer ace. Patience of a glacier, temper of an avalanche.

name: Greta Müller
bio: Valkyrie scout. Writes home about the scenery between contacts.
